Methods p. 6 give a prior-work pore-free density of 1.042 g/cm³, while Table 5 p. 10 gives rho_bulk 0.996 for the same unfoamed EPDM and rho_geom 0.996 ± 0.02. This internal theoretical-density mismatch is unresolved. Only measured rho_geom is proposed; theoretical rho_bulk and calculated porosities are excluded.
The paper calls these samples neat EPDM, but Table 1 includes 20.00 phr N550 carbon black and curatives. The identity must be the compound, never pure Vistalon or universal EPDM.

Table 5 discussion p. 10 calls the absent uncertainty of theoretical rho_bulk a missing standard deviation, suggesting SD for measured density columns. The exact statistical statement for rho_geom is nevertheless not explicit; preserve plus-minus type as unspecified and record this contextual clue.
